notes.title: Fix for Trouble's Achievement
notes.content:
Changes:

 Achievement for completing the game with Trouble is now working as intended.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Changes:

 Fixed an issue with permanent blessings applying right after beating the game.
 Added ability to dodge with right click.
 Fixed a small stutter that could occur when the first projectile hits an object.
 Performance improvements.
 Fixed a problem with taking screenshots with F5

notes.title: Launch / Stats & Achievements Fix
notes.content:
Roguely is live!

There were a few bugs at launch that have now been squashed. Most of them were stats and achievements related.

Thanks to everyone that has been playing so far and for your feedback! If you happen to run across any issues, let us know and we'll try to get them fixed ASAP!

Bug Fixes

Stats and achievements are now tracked correctly through Steam and will award stat based achievements correctly.
Added character unlock back into World 2 - Level 2.
Victory achievements are now checked correctly / awarded when earned.
Game timer now starts on level 1.
